description: Each token is a single centered cluster of flat, semi-transparent geometric primitives - triangles, squares/diamonds and circles - floating on a near-black charcoal ground, drawn in exactly two hues: a desaturated slate blue-grey and a burnt copper/terracotta orange. There is no line work, no texture and no gradient; all tonal variation comes from alpha accumulation where shapes overlap, giving a layered-acetate or stained-glass effect with muddy dark pools at the busiest crossings. Compositions are overwhelmingly radial and centered: a dominant large primitive with smaller satellite copies of the same primitive rotated around it, at symmetry orders from 3-fold to 12-fold. The twelve share the palette, the flat-translucent-polygon idiom and the centered radial logic; they differ in primitive family (roughly six triangle-dominant - 9011, 10264, 10622, 10801, 10980 and the snowflake 9190; three disc-based - 9369, 9906, 10085; two square/star - 9548, 10443; one chaotic pinwheel - 9727), in shape count (from two or three shapes in 10801 up to twenty-plus in 9190 and 9727), and in how much black margin they leave, with 9190, 9548 and 10980 pushing to or clipping the tile edge while 9011 and 10622 sit small and isolated. Across the three condition rows the same object is scaled, recolored and spread: stress contracts it markedly (9369's copper disc shrinks to roughly half its neutral diameter, 9548's spikes retract into a rounder blob, 9190's burst pulls in) and drains the orange toward grey, while recovery expands it past neutral, pushes the copper forward as the dominant hue and lets it reach or overrun the frame. Structure, symmetry order and primitive type are preserved across all three conditions - only size, alpha weight and warm/cool balance move.
seenAt120: Silhouette and palette survive cleanly; the two-hue scheme and the centered radial mass are legible at browse size. The disc family (9369, 9906, 10085) and the burst/star family (9190, 9548) stay instantly distinct, and 9727's pinwheel and 10980's scattered fragments read as their own things. Density and symmetry order survive. What thins out is the triangle family: 9011, 10264, 10622 and 10801 collapse toward the same read - a grey triangle with small orange bits - and 10622 in particular is so low-contrast against the black that it nearly disappears. Small interior detail (the tiny dark circles inside the discs, the small copper squares on 9369's ring, the notch shapes inside 9727) is lost entirely; only the outer mass and the hue split carry.
